feeds.title: Military Spouse
feeds.description: Military Spouse is here to simplify your crazy, wonderful military life. Militaryspouse.com is the official online community of Military Spouse Magazine. Find information and advice on deployment, PCSing, relationships, benefits, military families and more!

feeds.title: Soldier's Wife, Crazy Life
feeds.description: Support for Military Spouses going through deployments, pcsing or anything else the Military life throws at you. Our mission is to connect with other moms, military wives and anyone else who enjoys my posts.

feeds.title: National Military Family Association
feeds.description: Read the National Military Family Association's featured news on programs, policies, and events affecting military families. Our Mission: To strengthen and serve uniformed services families and to honor their service to the Nation. Together we're stronger.

feeds.title: Military Spouse JD Network Blog
feeds.description: The Military Spouse JD Network is an international network of legal professionals improving the lives of military families. We advocate for licensing accommodations for military spouses, including bar membership without additional examination.

feeds.title: MilSpouse Conversations Blog
feeds.description: MilSpouse Conversations is a diverse team of military spouses hosting a talk show and events having REAL and RELATABLE conversations to inspire you in all aspects of life.

feeds.title: Teach.Workout.Love
feeds.description: This is a motherhood community with a passion for writing and being a working mom. T.W.L is an outlet for moms to share their inspirations and creativity in balancing life, motherhood stories, life & style tips, being a military spouse, and staying healthy and fit.

feeds.title: For the Love of Food Blog
feeds.description: For the Love of Food is a blog for people who love to eat and love to cook. All the recipes can easily be made at home and are family-friendly and include step-by-step pictures. Most importantly, every post shared on For the Love of Food includes personal photos so the readers can truly connect with Nicole and her family and see that these recipes are cooked from the heart.

feeds.title: Everyday Wholesome
feeds.description: I am your EVERYDAY.. military wife, mommy of 3, Catholic convert, photographer, hippie homemaker, overachiever, essential oily, minimalist-ish with an unquenchable appetite for knowledge & sweets... striving to make every day WHOLESOME.

feeds.title: R. Riveter Blog
feeds.description: Canvas and Leather Handbags made by military spouses recycled materials Gifts for Spouse. Share the stories from Military Spouses who strive to inspire & empower others through portable careers, crafting quality handbags & purses.

feeds.title: Stories of Our Boys
feeds.description: Welcome to Stories of Our Boys, a Christian site related to all things motherhood, moving, faith, and occasionally some more girly things. I'm April, a happy and usually tired mother of four boys, ages seven through fourteen. I have been a stay-at-home mom for fourteen years now, so this site gives me a little space to pour my heart out to whoever I can convince to read it.

feeds.title: Three Little Ferns
feeds.description: Hello, and welcome! I'm Alex. I'm a military spouse and mama to three little girls. Currently, our family calls the Newport, Rhode Island area home, but we'll be on the move again next summer. I started this blog in 2012 ago while my husband was deployed to Afghanistan. I wanted an outlet to share my knowledge and ideas about the military and being an Army wife. In the 6 years since starting this blog, I've expanded to include posts about parenting, DIY and craft projects, traveling, and recipes.

feeds.title: Loving Life Moore
feeds.description: Hi, My name is Melissa. I created a blog as a sort of diary to chronicle my thoughts and feelings, as well as the journey we were embarking on together. Loving Life Moore is a lifestyle, Travel, and family blog based wherever the Army sends us.

feeds.title: Jessica Lynn Writes Blog
feeds.description: I'm an Air Force wife and mom with three kids currently living in Germany. I'm always planning our next trip and feeding my hungry family with easy meals. If I'm not doing one of those two things, you'll probably find me drinking a second cup of coffee, reading a book, or taking a nap.

feeds.title: The Homes I Have Made
feeds.description: I'm a wife to a U.S. Marine and mom to two boys! We are a military family, living in our 7th home in 11 years! I specialize in renter-friendly, movable, and budget-wise décor and organizational solutions that are high on style, function, and simplicity.

feeds.title: The Seasoned Spouse Blog
feeds.description: I'm Lizann, a military spouse and your new friend! I wanted a space to connect with other MilSpouses and share my experiences, so we can get through this crazy military life together! Tips and advice for Military Spouses, Girlfriends, or anyone with an SO in the military!

feeds.title: The Stay-at-Home-Mom Survival Guide Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Jaimi Erickson. I am glad you stopped by. I love offering you tools that have helped me get my life and family in balance. A complete guide for Stay-at-Home Moms, covering kids' activities, homemaking tips, simple recipes, natural Living, and encouragement for moms to embrace the season of parenting. Authored by Jaimi Erickson.

feeds.title: Mamas and Coffee Blog
feeds.description: MomJonz wants to empower women in life by sharing her family's stories and adventures. We a are a military family that loves to travel, laugh, and good ole fun. Sit back and enjoy our adventures. Wait, let me rephrase, my mission is to empower ALL people!

feeds.title: Militarywives.com
feeds.description: Military oriented website specifically for wives and families of military personnel. This site will teach you about the United States Armed Forces with knowledge on ranks, medals, and much more.

feeds.title: The Daily Impressions
feeds.description: I started this blog to not only share pieces of my family's journey through life but to also be a resource to Army wives, moms and parents who love to be active with small children. Get information on accessible luxury travel experiences both Domestically and Internationally with small children.

feeds.title: Modern Military Mother Blog
feeds.description: Clare Macnaughton is a modern military mother; a feminist, a British military spouse, and a lifestyle journalist writing about real-life adventures.

feeds.title: Jocelyn Green Blog
feeds.description: Jocelyn Green inspires faith and courage in her readers through both fiction and nonfiction. A former military wife herself, she offers encouragement and hope to military wives worldwide through her Faith Deployed ministry.

feeds.title: The Meat & Potatoes of Life Blog
feeds.description: Lisa Smith Molinari is an author, public speaker and award winning blogger and self-syndicated newspaper columnist. She has been a Navy wife for over 20 years, and is the mother of three teenagers. She shares her humorous stories about the realities of marriage, parenting and military life on her blog and in her columns.

feeds.title: Extra Black Olives
feeds.description: I'm Lisa, the sorority woman turned Army wife. Stay up to date with my blog posts.

feeds.title: The Cullinan Family
feeds.description: Get military wife updates from The Cullinan Family Blog.

feeds.title: The Military Wife and Mom Blog
feeds.description: The Military Wife and Mom blog are so much more than 'it's my way or the highway.' Around here, I give you the tools you need to achieve your goals - whether it's creating a peaceful home and connected relationship with your kids or conquering deployment and building a rock-solid military marriage.

feeds.title: Jen Woodhouse Blog
feeds.description: Jen Woodhouse authors The House of Wood as her creative outlet for all things DIY and design, where she documents her adventures in woodworking, interior design, military life, marriage, and motherhood. She offers in-depth tutorials that inspire and encourage readers to build their way to a more beautiful home.

feeds.title: Blue Star Families Blog
feeds.description: Blue Star Families is the source for all things military family-related. The mission of Blue Star Families is to strengthen military families and connect America to the military.

feeds.title: The Frugal Navy Wife Blog
feeds.description: The Frugal Navy Wife Blog covers articles that help you how to save money on every part of your life from food to DIY, homeschooling, travel, and more. The Frugal Navy Wife is a military wife's guide to savings in civilian life.

feeds.title: Jo, My Gosh! Blog
feeds.description: Military life can be an adventure. It can be full of frustrations and worries, but it's also overflowing with opportunities and joy. ut I learned so much and I'm so excited to share everything with you. The Jo, My Gosh! community is here for you through every deployment and every PCS, through each care package and each video call. You don't have to be alone.

feeds.title: The MILLIE Journal
feeds.description: Millie is more than a service designed to help military families move from base to base. We are a state of mind. We are an effort bound by our military experiences, we believe in the strength of military families.

feeds.title: Sandee Booth Blog
feeds.description: I'm Sandee. A Georgia mama to 3 beautiful blessings + military wife to my college sweetheart. You'll find all sorts of inspiration from home and personal style to family recipes, to fun travels and giveaways.

feeds.title: Military With Kids
feeds.description: I'm Jill. I run MilitaryWithKids as a resource and community for military families. I am a military spouse of almost 10 years and a mom of two very active boys. MilitaryWithKids was designed with YOU in mind! Each of us has been tackling the challenge of PCSing, swimming in the fluidity of military spouse careers, constantly changing social networks, navigating Tricare, dealing with deployments, deciphering military lingo all while embracing the advantage of military discount benefits separately

feeds.title: Semi-Delicate Balance
feeds.description: A chronicle of the balance that moms & military spouses face today. Read more personal stories, advice, insights here!

feeds.title: Military Spouse Advocacy Network
feeds.description: Military Spouse Advocacy Network's mission is to create stronger military families through education, empowerment and support. MSAN provides information on resources, benefits, education and career opportunities, deployment & reintegration support, guidance for new military spouses, financial resources, and health & wellness.

feeds.title: Married to Navy Blog
feeds.description: Serving children and adults. Education and training combined with compassion. A journey that leads to wellness and recovery. Counseling in California.

feeds.title: Gift a Soldier
feeds.description: The ultimate gift guide for the Military community. Here we offer the best gifts for all military occassions like graduation, deployment, retirement, etc.

feeds.title: Heart & Stripes
feeds.description: I am a coffee loving blogger, military spouse, stay at home mom and an Army Veteran living with PTSD. I love sharing our adventures of life, love and everything in between!

feeds.title: The Deployment Diatribes
feeds.description: Erin started this blog to support the military community by offering support, sharing experiences and finding good deals for military families. Get information and conversation about military family life, expat life, no nonsense parenting, and surviving deployment & temporary single parenting.

feeds.title: Devotional Diva
feeds.description: I'm glad you've found your way here! I'm Maggie, owner and editor-in-chief. I'm a US military wife, mommy and pet lover. As a Christian, I'm striving to spread love. At Devotional Diva, I devote myself to inspiring women, spurring them forward and helping them share their stories!

feeds.title: Planting Roots - Christian Military Wives & Service Women
feeds.description: Planting Roots is a nonprofit organization encouraging military women to grow in their faith. Their vision is that military women will be deeply rooted in Christ.

feeds.title: Somewhere Over the Camo
feeds.description: The journey through life post Army as a redhead, wife, baby-momma, fur-mom, friend, sister and daughter.

feeds.title: Crafty Brooklyn Army Wife
feeds.description: My name is Alisha. I am sharing my love of sewing, knitting, photography, paper crafts, cooking and baking.

feeds.title: Rants of a Desi Military Wife Living life verily, merrily
feeds.description: Rants of a Desi Military Wife is a blog about exactly that. A desi military wife ranting through her days and her nights about everything.

feeds.title: Real Life Army Wife
feeds.description: Welcome to the 'Journal Of Our Journey'. My husband and I married in May 2000. We are the proud parents of a handsome 11 year-old son, our li'l Razorback, and a beautiful 7 year-old girl, our li'l Tarheel! Once an RN, right now my full-time job is being an Army wife and homeschool mom. My husband surrendered to the Lord's ministry and is a Chaplain in the US Army.

feeds.title: Life of an Army Wife
feeds.description: Army Wife struggling with physical health issues including infertility. This blog is really all about my life, how I live it, and my life experiences I will now share a few with you.

feeds.title: Mia Cucina, Mia Famiglia, Mia Vita
feeds.description: Catholic. Army wife. Mom of four. Rockabilly obsessed. Foodie. Coffee during the day. Wine and hard cider at night. Violinist. Avid reader. Wanderlust. Welcome to my crazy life.

feeds.title: Military Wife Entertains Star Spangled Entertaining
feeds.description: Northern Virginia native Cassie shares the successes and failures that she have experienced over her 28 years as an active duty wife with seven kids-eleven deployments-fourteen moves- anything and everything, oh and cancer, too.

feeds.title: Boldly Rise | Christian women living: the home, military, and world
feeds.description: I'm Brittany, creator of Boldly Rise. I am recently married to the most wonderful man God could've given me. I am recently trying to get acquainted to military life as a military wife. It is my goal to help you, advise you, encourage you, and share with you on all things related to being a Christian woman.

feeds.title: Marathons and Dog Tags
feeds.description: I'm a 31 year old Army Wife, married to my amazing husband, Kyle for 9 years. I'm a mama to Emersyn, runner, volunteer and lover of all things Disney. This blog is my diary and I blog about everythingfrom marriage, family, running, our infertility struggles, pregnancy, and our crazy adventures with the Army.

feeds.title: Anchors Aweigh
feeds.description: I'm Chelsea, he's Parker, and the furry one is Jenny. We love living the military adventure and think life is just really beautiful.

feeds.title: Scrappin' Navy Wife
feeds.description: My name is Nikki. I am a Navy wife, my cat's slave, music lover, and a card maker.

feeds.title: Our marine corps adventure
feeds.description: Hi there! Thanks for stopping by our little corner of the blogging world. I'm a Marine Corps wife and mom to 4 wild and crazy kids. Pull up a chair and read about our exciting (and not so exciting) lives as a Marine Corps family!

feeds.title: airbornewife's Stamping Spot
feeds.description: Creations and random thoughts of an Army Wife, Mom and Stamper.

feeds.title: The LDS Air Force Wife
feeds.description: I am a member of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter Day Saints. My husband is a Captain in the US Air Force. I have three adorable kids and I love to teach yoga. This blog is about our family, the LDS church, and our journey through the US Air Force.

feeds.title: Come Fly With Us
feeds.description: Come Fly With Us is a lifestyle blog written by Janelle Cook that focuses on marriage, DIY crafts, recipes, fitness, and the military (Air Force) lifestyle.

feeds.title: Black Military Wives Blog
feeds.description: Black Military Wives, LLC (B.M.W.) was created for the unique, cultural needs of Black women who are/were connected to the military by marriage OR their own service in the military. The purpose of B.M.W. is to provide emotional support and information to women who are/were officially affiliated with the DoD branches of the United States Armed Forces (Air Force, Army, Navy or Marine Corps).

feeds.title: Olive Oyl, Navy wife. | The crazed ramblings of a wife of a Royal Naval Sailor
feeds.description: Hi! I started this blog yonks ago as a way to cheer up the other Navy wives on my (then) fiances ship. Basically my blog is a space for me to talk about the real life stuff that happens when you are a Royal Navy Wife.

feeds.title: A Modern Navy Wife
feeds.description: A Modern Navy Wife is a lifestyle blog from a gal who is living, loving and learning from an ever-changing life, thanks in large part to the US Navy!

feeds.title: World Traveling Military Family
feeds.description: Military Family living all over the world. The author blogs about traveling, photography, crafting, & more! She loves being traveling to new locations, meeting new friends along the way, and of course posting about all their adventures!

feeds.title: Pearl and Style
feeds.description: Hi friends! Welcome to Pearl and Style! My name is Rachel. So nice to meet you! My family and I live in sunny San Diego, California. I'm married to my best friend and he is an active duty US Navy (that makes us a military family). I'm a mom to a very beautiful little girl who is a mini version of me and to a fur baby. I have been wanting to start this blog for so long, but I have always been terrified. I don't even know why. Then, one day in the middle of these uncharted times when we are all in community quarantine, I decided to take on this huge step and pursue my dreams.

feeds.title: The Prickly Pilot's Wife
feeds.description: The Prickly Pilot's Wife is a lifestyle blog for those wanting to learn more uses for essential oils and about military spouse life.

feeds.title: Whimsical September - Military Life
feeds.description: I'm grateful to be called Mom by two little girls ages 1 and 3, and I'm a super proud Army wife. Our family is currently stationed in Manhattan, Kansas at Fort Riley. I write almost daily about our family's lives in general, and though I like to keep things light, I also share the occasionally chaotic parts too.

feeds.title: My Military Lifestyle
feeds.description: A fun lifestyle blog for military spouses, featuring frugal living ideas, budget-friendly recipes, and tips for how to survive military life! Find the best money saving tips, frugal recipes, fun DIY ideas & TONS more!

feeds.title: PCSgrades Blog
feeds.description: PCSgrades helps when your family has received PCS orders for a military move across the country. We have trusted reviews by and for military families.

feeds.title: Design Addict Mom
feeds.description: A lifestyle blog sharing interior trends, diy ideas, and glimpses at motherhood. The author of this blog is a military wife, mama of two boys.

feeds.title: NextGen MilSpouse
feeds.description: NextGen MilSpouse is the online destination for today's military spouse. We deliver fresh perspectives on current events, career advice, small business development, personal finance, and relationships from our dynamic team of military spouse thought leaders via our website, social channels, weekly newsletter, and podcast.

feeds.title: Mrs. Navy Mama
feeds.description: Welcome! My name is Noralee, and I am Mrs. Navy Mama. I am the mother of four beautiful children, and the wife of a Navy officer, and they all keep my life interesting and busy. We move and start over an average of every 2 years and I am here to tell you that it's not always easy, but totally worth it.

feeds.title: Jen McDonald Blog
feeds.description: As a milspouse of nearly 30 years, I'm also now the mom of an active duty son. We've been through what many military families go through: years of separation due to deployments and TDYs, frequent relocations, separation from extended family, hoping we're doing right in raising our military kids...all of it. Here you will find Hope & humor for military families, raising military kids, strengthening your military marriage, getting through deployments and PCS military moves, and more!

feeds.title: The Lewnited States
feeds.description: Keep up with articles from The Lewnited States.

feeds.title: The Military Spouse Coach
feeds.description: Coaching military spouses individually and in small groups, writing and speaking on military spouse topics. Their mission is to empower spouses to pursue careers that align with their values, skills, and interests and; complement their military lifestyle.

feeds.title: A Beautiful, Camouflaged, Mess of A Life
feeds.description: Hi! I am a cradle Catholic, proud Army wife, stay at home mother, & social worker. I blog about my faith, Army life from a wife's perspective, and parenthood!

feeds.title: Mil Spouse Mama
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Micah. I'm a Jesus-loving, USMC milspouse mama of three boys whom I lug with me all over the world. When asked where I want to visit, I always answer the same: everywhere!

feeds.title: Mrs Rollman Blog
feeds.description: I am Karen otherwise known as Mrs Rollman. I am the owner of this little blog. I am a military wife, a Respiratory Therapist, and a lover of all things decor! This blog is a creative outlet for me to share my love of decorating and design and to hopefully inspire all of you who come by and read it.
